If the zombie apocalypse starts at a theme park, don't run for the exit.
Nora is seventeen. First summer job, running the Ferris wheel.
Without knowing it, she is standing under one of the safest places in the park.
But only if she doesn't make one very stupid mistake.
Thirty thousand visitors have the same idea. Get to the front gate.
No. One gate, thirty thousand people. That's exactly where the infected are.
Rule number one. Get off the ground. They can't climb.
She locks the wheel, with her cabin at the very top. Two hundred feet up.
Up here, she has two bottles of water, a bag of kettle corn, one radio,
and Pickles, a goose who hates absolutely everyone.
On paper, she could last up here for three days.
At eight p.m., the park turns itself on. Twenty thousand lights. Music.
Then the radio crackles. Nora. Don't come down.
And the wheel starts to move.
Someone is in the control booth.
